race.comment: Waller has the numbers but Tulloch Lodge's LOW KEY (9) appeals as the one to beat in the opener. Started at $1.45 when resuming last start over 1150m at the Kensington track but after leading for home found one better. Strips fitter and will appreciate getting out to this trip. Expect Clark to roll forward and give them something to catch. SNITZEL'S GIRL (13) started at $26 and never looked a winning hope when resuming over 1100m at Canterbury last start. McDonald goes on and the extra 300m is a plus. VICTORIOUS RULER (14) is ready to fire first-up off the back of three trials. Placed at both runs in the maiden prep so she has her share of talent. IOMMI (3) returned in good shape at Canterbury last start and is open to plenty of improvement. Les Bridge's The Autumn Sun first starter SAPPHIRE LEGEND (12) has been thereabouts in a couple of recent trials and should hit the ground running
